shields_note: Posted 'Defensive Shields(10)' outside the 60; nine are dested. The tenth, 'Allegations of Corruption', is a Dark Side shield with no Light Side card of that name, so it is not shown as a card.
notes: Starting cards marked (S) in the post: We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection & Aim High, Staging Areas, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice, An Unusual Amount Of Fear, Inner Strength; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'Qui-Gonn's Saber' dested Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (Reflections III), the lightsaber-combat saber the strategy builds around, not Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine); 'Luke's Saber' dested Luke's Lightsaber.

Posted 'Home OneDocking Bay' and 'NabooTheed Palace ...' (missing colons) dested Home One: Docking Bay and the Light Naboo: Theed Palace sites; 'Nar Shadda Wind Chimes' dested Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes; 'Millenium Falcon' dested Millennium Falcon.

Posted 'Insurrection/Aim High', 'Do or Do Not/Wise Advice' and 'The Bith Shuffle/Desperate Reach' dested as the combo cards; 'Staging Areas' is posted on its own line and dested Staging Areas (Death Star II).

Shields Your Insight Serves You Well, Battle Plan, Ultimatum, Ounee Ta and Don't Do That Again dested their Reflections III Defensive Shield pages; 'Planetary Defenenses' dested Planetary Defenses; 'He can go about his Buisness' dested He Can Go About His Business.
Posted shield 'Allegations of Corruption' is a Dark Side card; the Light Side has none by that name, so it is left out of the shield table and described in the shields note.
The strategy says Losing Track was later swapped for You'll Find I'm Full Of Surprises; the list is kept as published.
